//: PARAMS DOCUMENT for policy/interventions.py. Values only. Free swap, no compile.
//1: The interventions themselves are code (one @intervention step each) because each one
//2: is an arithmetic comparison with a named actual and a named threshold, and doc 08 3.2
//3: says arithmetic is code. What lives here is the threshold, its scope and its bounds.
//4: Scoping is by params NAMESPACE, which is why there are four product sub-objects rather
//5: than a `scope` field: doc 03 4.1 namespaces params per module INSTANCE, and the four
//6: product arms are four instances. A product team edits its own object on a Wednesday
//7: without touching the other three and without a Credit Risk Policy cycle (AC 9).

con_int_03_min_instalment_relief_pct.note: A balance transfer has no instalment. CON-INT-03 is evaluated against the STRESSED payment, and the product team holds the floor at 0 because the stressed payment is already the binding test.

con_int_05_max_term_extension_months.note: NOT APPLICABLE, not passed. Product 20 has no term. The intervention emits na(), which is a third state that the record distinguishes from a pass (spec 5.7.6).

con_int_06_rate_ceiling_mode.note: Evaluated against the REVERSION rate, never the promotional rate.

A secured refinance may price above the settled accounts' weighted rate by up to 150bp, because the settled accounts were unsecured and the comparison is not like for like. Product-scoped, and the base value is still `binding`.

con_int_14_min_post_discretionary.note: Higher than product 11 because the vehicle carries a compulsory comprehensive insurance premium the client must keep paying.

con_int_03_min_instalment_relief_pct.note: Deliberately high. If securing unsecured debt against a home does not release at least a fifth of the instalment, it is not worth the consequence of default changing from a judgment to the loss of the property.

con_int_04_anti_harm_max_cost_uplift_pct.note: Evaluated against the MANDATORY 84-month sub-term amortisation, not the bond's remaining term. Against a 240-month term this threshold is unreachable by construction, which is the point: the sub-term structure is what makes product 40 defensible, and the anti-harm rule is what makes the sub-term structure mandatory.

con_int_05_max_term_extension_months.note: Applied to the 84-month sub-term, not to the bond.

short_circuit.note: 5.4's short-circuit. Every condition is evaluated and every verdict recorded even when the first one already settles it, because 'we could only lend you R14 000' from a client who later learns a consolidation would have released R60 000 is a complaint, and the answer must be on file.

settlement_mechanics.revolving_paydown_note: Revolving debt has no natural term, so the before-and-after comparison needs an assumed one. It is a declared parameter rather than a number in someone's head.
